Each moment is positive. k=1 gives -1, k>=2 yields absolute value greater than 1, and nonsquarefree values are even; hence no composite is -1. Standalone exact integer checks independently compare floor and divisor recurrences through 900 and full formula/parity/primality through 10000. Finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The motivating paper poses a natural family of power-kernel recurrences, but its symbolic prime characterization does not determine a fixed nonlinear specialization. A complete formula for every squarefree input reveals ordered-Bell moment coefficients, exact sign and nontrivial magnitude as the support size grows, and yields a concrete all-integer prime criterion when coupled to the Möbius-parity invariant. The arbitrarily many-prime evaluation exceeds the known p²/pq cases and resolves a genuinely motivated structural question; neither correct arithmetic nor novelty by itself is used as a substitute for this mathematical motivation.
